_comment: The composited bucket, same as the 1.21.4 node's. What moved at 1.21.11 is the MODEL LOADER of
that name -- `neoforge:fluid_container` is no longer one of those (only empty, obj and composite
are) -- but the ITEM model of the same name survives, which is what this is. The plain fallback in
models/item is what vanilla reaches for if this is ever absent.
